JUNIOR ANALYST
ABOUT THE ROLE
Deeter Analytics is a privately held investment research and trading firm managing its own capital across public markets. After years of discretionary success, we think we have some unique ways of seeing the market, and we pair sharp human judgment with modern AI to act on them.
Our trading day runs on rhythm: what reports tonight and how we're positioned, what moved before the open, and how the tape is trading versus the story. We're hiring a Junior Analyst to own that rhythm. Reporting to the senior analyst who anchors our daily markets coverage, you'll keep the desk's picture of the market current, complete, and decision-ready from pre-market through the close - digesting a large flow of information quickly and turning it into concise output the team can act on. It's an entry point into a serious seat: master the daily rhythm, and the role grows with you into deeper research responsibility. The role is full-time and fully remote, on US market hours.

- The morning picture. The pre-market summary the desk opens the day with - concise, prioritized, and on time every day.
- The calendar. Earnings and events tracking for the names we own and watch: who reports when (to the minute), how we're positioned, and what matters into the print.
- Intraday color. Checkpoint notes through the session so the desk always has a current read on the tape.
- Lists, screens, and alerts. Maintain the desk's watchlists, thematic baskets, and stub positions; set alerts; and build same-day breakdowns and screens when someone needs a question answered.
- Ad-hoc desk support. Fast, accurate answers under time constraints: data pulls, fact-checks, liquidity and sizing context, and whatever else the day demands.
- AI leverage. Use modern AI tools to widen your coverage, summarize at scale, and cut noise.
